text:
sam: FYI terraform plan for nv6 cross-region scale-up got blocked by premerge OPA check in CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/242 — canary rollout is now on hold. Need guidance on exemption path or alternative plan.

maya: ugh. saw it. OPA deny: 'deny[reason] = "egress to 0.0.0.0/0 not allowed for nv-pools"' — but we didn't change egress rules, the new subnet module defaults to 0.0.0.0/0 for mgmt. I'll paste the plan output.

maya: ```plan snippet
module.gpu_pool.google_compute_subnetwork.default: will be created
+ resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "default" {
  ip_cidr_range = "10.4.0.0/20"
  private_ip_google_access = true
  # BUG: default routes = "0.0.0.0/0" when region != us-central1
}
OPA: deny[0] = "egress-policy-violation: public-egress-detected"
```

infra-bot: CI policy check failed: conftest/opa v0.34 - policy: /policies/network/egress.rego - Result: deny

amar: :eyes: This is coming from the shared network module version bump. We hit the same in staging last week.

jen: What's the risk if we temporarily exempt this PR? We need the capacity boost for eu-west1 nv6 to avoid 503s during batch jobs tonight.

sam: Current SLA is degrading — spike in queue times for dedicated tenants in eu-west1. If we don't apply, jobs will back up.

maya: We can do two options: 1) Split the change: apply the nv6 pool only in eu-west1 with explicit egress rule override (safe), 2) Request a one-off OPA exemption via 'policy-exemption' flow (requires eng-lead + security ack and audit note). Which do people prefer?

amar: I can do option 1 now: propose patch to set 'subnetwork.egress = private' for eu-west1 only. But that'll require a targeted terraform apply and will bypass some modules. Also will need to update gitops helm values.

jen: If we go exemption route, we must record the justification and attach the canary plan. Security wants a rollback plan and limited TTL on the exemption.

sam: Can someone triage quickly? If we miss the evening window, capacity shortage will cause costlier emergency provisioning.

maya: I'll open a PR with the minimal override and tag @jen for security signoff. If security can't sign within 2 hours, we'll fall back to emergency exemption and run 'policy-exempt apply' with audit hooks.

deploy-bot: Blocked pipeline: premerge -> policy -> fail. To rerun: https://ci.redwood.run/runs/7654

amar: Quick checklist if we do manual exemption:
1) Submit policy-exemption ticket #infra-726
2) Attach plan + canary scope
3) Add TTL = 4h and postmortem owner
4) Run `terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool["eu-west1"]`
5) Monitor console tokens/latency for 30m
I'll take ownership if nobody objects.

jen: :+1: please add me as approver on the ticket and include a rollback terraform cmd.

sam: Thanks — please comment in the PR and I'll coordinate comms to SRE and customers if we need emergency capacity changes.
